# Hunny Farm

> Hunny Farm is a small-batch raw honey brand. Four single-source honeys — White Clover, Linden, Tupelo and Florida Red — each gathered where its flower grows best, then bottled by hand in Lake County, Illinois. Sold in one-pound (16 oz) glass jars. Raw, unfiltered, unheated. Also from the farm: Buckwheat Honey (South Dakota) and Wisconsin Maple Syrup.

Contact: contact@hunnyfarm.com · Instagram @thehunnyfarm · Facebook /TheHunnyFarm

## Products
- [White Clover Honey](https://hunnyfarm.com/honey/white-clover): sweet, cinnamon, apple pie. Sweet-clover fields, summer harvest. $15 / 1 lb.
- [Linden Honey](https://hunnyfarm.com/honey/linden): floral, pear, citrus. Basswood, Driftless area of Wisconsin, June harvest. $15 / 1 lb.
- [Tupelo Honey](https://hunnyfarm.com/honey/tupelo): buttery, floral, mild. White Ogeechee tupelo, river swamps of northwest Florida, spring harvest. Rarely crystallizes. $20 / 1 lb.
- [Florida Red Honey](https://hunnyfarm.com/honey/florida-red): bold, tangy, sweet. Black titi and spring wildflowers, Florida Panhandle. $15 / 1 lb.

## Journal
- [What's actually in a jar of honey](https://hunnyfarm.com/journal/what-is-in-a-jar-of-honey): how nectar becomes honey, what "raw" means, why honey never spoils.
- [Your honey turned solid. That's the good news.](https://hunnyfarm.com/journal/your-honey-turned-solid): crystallization explained and how to reverse it.
- [Why tupelo costs five dollars more](https://hunnyfarm.com/journal/why-tupelo-costs-more): single-source honey, one tree, one short season.
- [A field guide to buckwheat honey](https://hunnyfarm.com/journal/field-guide-to-buckwheat): the dark, malty honey and what to do with it.
- [Three weeks in June](https://hunnyfarm.com/journal/three-weeks-in-june): the linden harvest in the Driftless.

## Facts
- Brand: Hunny Farm ("Specialty Honey"). Bottled in Lake County, Illinois, USA.
- All honey is raw and unfiltered; it will crystallize over time; warm-water bath overnight re-liquefies it.
- Store status: not yet shipping (first bottling in progress). Email for notification.
